Champion.description: Focuses on the development of raw physical power honed to perfection.

3.name: Improved Critical
3.tldr: Your weapon attack rolls score a critical hit on a roll of 19 or 20.

7.name: Remarkable Athlete
7.tldr: Add half your proficiency bonus to any Strength, Dexterity, or Constitution check you make that doesn't use proficiency.

10.name: Additional Fighting Style
10.tldr: You can choose a second option from the Fighting Style class feature.

15.name: Superior Critical
15.tldr: Your weapon attack rolls score a critical hit on a roll of 18, 19, or 20.

18.name: Survivor
18.tldr: Regain hit points at the start of your turn if you have fewer than half your hit points left and are alive.

Battle Master.description: Focuses on martial prowess, utilizing disciplined combat maneuvers in battle.

3.name: Combat Superiority
3.tldr: Gain superiority dice and learn specialized combat maneuvers that add tactical effects to attacks.

3.name: Student of War
3.tldr: Gain proficiency with one artisan's tool of your choice.

7.name: Know Your Enemy
7.tldr: Spend time observing a creature to learn information about its combat capabilities compared to your own.

10.name: Improved Combat Superiority
10.tldr: Your superiority dice turn into d10s.

15.name: Relentless
15.tldr: When you roll initiative and have no superiority dice remaining, you regain one superiority die.

18.name: Improved Combat Superiority
18.tldr: Your superiority dice turn into d12s.

Eldritch Knight.description: Combines martial mastery with the ability to cast abjuration and evocation magic.

3.name: Spellcasting
3.tldr: Cast wizard spells using Intelligence as your spellcasting ability.

3.name: Weapon Bond
3.tldr: Create a magical bond with up to two weapons so they can never be disarmed and can be summoned back instantly.

7.name: War Magic
7.tldr: When you use your action to cast a cantrip, you can make one weapon attack as a bonus action.

10.name: Eldritch Strike
10.tldr: When you hit a creature with a weapon attack, it has disadvantage on saving throws against your next spell.

15.name: Arcane Charge
15.tldr: Teleport up to 30 feet when you use your Action Surge.

18.name: Improved War Magic
18.tldr: When you use your action to cast a spell, you can make one weapon attack as a bonus action.
